completed_steps: Identified critical mathematical defects: hardcoded zero curvature in Frenet texture, missing anterior trough narrowing in CPU path, volume-depth Z mismatch in overlay, missing FDI tooth badge rendering, possible FDI wrap-around
Implemented Frenet-Serret physical curvature calculation kappa (mm^-1) in calculateArchTangentsAndNormals
Eliminated interactive drag string allocation thrashing in fitSmoothDentalArchSpline
Populated true curvature in Row 1 of WebGL2 2-row Frenet texture (splineBuf[idx1 + 2])
Implemented physiological anterior trough narrowing (anteriorTroughRatio 0.5..0.8, default 0.65) in both WebGL2 shader uniforms and CPU panoramic reconstruct loop
Implemented quadrant-aware FDI tooth anchor mapping to guarantee strictly monotonic FDI 18..48 without cross-arch wrap-around
Exported and validated isCrossSectionBasisOrthonormal for transverse cross-sections
Corrected panoramic overlay Z-height mapping for axial line and implant projection to align with activePano.centerZMm
Implemented interactive FDI tooth badges along top margin of panorama in drawPanoramicOverlay
Expanded test suite cbctPanoramicMath.test.ts with 7 new comprehensive tests (28 passed in 12 suites, Exit Code 0)
Executed per-file git add on strictly isolated scope files

findings.defect: Curvature hardcoded to 0.0 in WebGL2 2-row Frenet frame texture
findings.fix: Interpolate physical curvature kappa from ArchVectorNode and store in splineBuf[idx1 + 2]

findings.defect: CPU panoramic reconstruction ignored anterior trough narrowing, causing incisor blur
findings.fix: Calculate colFocalRadiusMm with smooth tapering based on anteriorTroughRatio (0.5..0.8) and centerNorm

findings.defect: Axial plane line in drawPanoramicOverlay was mapped using overall volume depth instead of panoramic vertical FOV
findings.fix: Map crosshairMm.z into panoramic FOV [centerZMm - panoHMm/2, centerZMm + panoHMm/2] and use panoHMm / heightPx for slab corridor

findings.defect: FDI tooth badges were never rendered on top of panorama despite hitTestPanoramicToothMarker expecting them
findings.fix: Render clinical FDI badge pills along top margin (y=4..20px) in Pass 2 with hover/selected highlights

findings.defect: Potential cross-arch FDI wrap-around under narrow or distorted arches
